title: Psalm 145 · second version
opening_line: O Lord, thou art my God and King;

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: O Lord, thou art my God and King;
text.normalized: O Lord, thou art my God and King;
text.reading: O Lord, thou art my God and King;

text.diplomatic: Thee will I magnify and praise:
text.normalized: Thee will I magnify and praise:
text.reading: Thee will I magnify and praise:

text.diplomatic: I will thee bless, and gladly sing
text.normalized: I will thee bless, and gladly sing
text.reading: I will thee bless, and gladly sing

text.diplomatic: Unto thy holy name always.
text.normalized: Unto thy holy name always.
text.reading: Unto thy holy name always.

text.diplomatic: Each day I rise I will thee bless,
text.normalized: Each day I rise I will thee bless,
text.reading: Each day I rise I will thee bless,

text.diplomatic: And praise thy name time without end.
text.normalized: And praise thy name time without end.
text.reading: And praise thy name time without end.

text.diplomatic: Much to be praised, and great God is;
text.normalized: Much to be praised, and great God is;
text.reading: Much to be praised, and great God is;

text.diplomatic: His greatness none can comprehend.
text.normalized: His greatness none can comprehend.
text.reading: His greatness none can comprehend.

text.diplomatic: Race shall thy works praise unto race,
text.normalized: Race shall thy works praise unto race,
text.reading: Race shall thy works praise unto race,

text.diplomatic: The mighty acts show done by thee.
text.normalized: The mighty acts show done by thee.
text.reading: The mighty acts show done by thee.

text.diplomatic: I will speak of the glorious grace,
text.normalized: I will speak of the glorious grace,
text.reading: I will speak of the glorious grace,

text.diplomatic: And honour of thy majesty;
text.normalized: And honour of thy majesty;
text.reading: And honour of thy majesty;

text.diplomatic: Thy wondrous works I will record.
text.normalized: Thy wondrous works I will record.
text.reading: Thy wondrous works I will record.

text.diplomatic: By men the might shall be extolled
text.normalized: By men the might shall be extolled
text.reading: By men the might shall be extolled

text.diplomatic: Of all thy dreadful acts, O LORD:
text.normalized: Of all thy dreadful acts, O LORD:
text.reading: Of all thy dreadful acts, O LORD:

text.diplomatic: And I thy greatness will unfold.
text.normalized: And I thy greatness will unfold.
text.reading: And I thy greatness will unfold.

text.diplomatic: They utter shall abundantly
text.normalized: They utter shall abundantly
text.reading: They utter shall abundantly

text.diplomatic: The mem’ry of thy goodness great;
text.normalized: The mem’ry of thy goodness great;
text.reading: The mem’ry of thy goodness great;

text.diplomatic: And shall sing praises cheerfully,
text.normalized: And shall sing praises cheerfully,
text.reading: And shall sing praises cheerfully,

text.diplomatic: Whilst they thy righteousness relate.
text.normalized: Whilst they thy righteousness relate.
text.reading: Whilst they thy righteousness relate.

text.diplomatic: The LORD our God is gräcious,
text.normalized: The LORD our God is gräcious,
text.reading: The LORD our God is gräcious,

text.diplomatic: Compassionate is he also;
text.normalized: Compassionate is he also;
text.reading: Compassionate is he also;

text.diplomatic: In mercy he is plenteous,
text.normalized: In mercy he is plenteous,
text.reading: In mercy he is plenteous,

text.diplomatic: But unto wrath and anger slow.
text.normalized: But unto wrath and anger slow.
text.reading: But unto wrath and anger slow.

text.diplomatic: Good unto all men is the LORD:
text.normalized: Good unto all men is the LORD:
text.reading: Good unto all men is the LORD:

text.diplomatic: O’er all his works his mercy is.
text.normalized: O’er all his works his mercy is.
text.reading: O’er all his works his mercy is.

text.diplomatic: Thy works all praise to thee afford:
text.normalized: Thy works all praise to thee afford:
text.reading: Thy works all praise to thee afford:

text.diplomatic: Thy saints, O LORD, thy name shall bless.
text.normalized: Thy saints, O LORD, thy name shall bless.
text.reading: Thy saints, O LORD, thy name shall bless.

text.diplomatic: The glory of thy kingdom show
text.normalized: The glory of thy kingdom show
text.reading: The glory of thy kingdom show

text.diplomatic: Shall they, and of thy power tell:
text.normalized: Shall they, and of thy power tell:
text.reading: Shall they, and of thy power tell:

text.diplomatic: That so men’s sons his deeds may know,
text.normalized: That so men’s sons his deeds may know,
text.reading: That so men’s sons his deeds may know,

text.diplomatic: His kingdom’s grace that doth excel.
text.normalized: His kingdom’s grace that doth excel.
text.reading: His kingdom’s grace that doth excel.

text.diplomatic: Thy kingdom hath none end at all,
text.normalized: Thy kingdom hath none end at all,
text.reading: Thy kingdom hath none end at all,

text.diplomatic: It doth through ages all remain.
text.normalized: It doth through ages all remain.
text.reading: It doth through ages all remain.

text.diplomatic: The LORD upholdeth all that fall,
text.normalized: The LORD upholdeth all that fall,
text.reading: The LORD upholdeth all that fall,

text.diplomatic: The cast-down raiseth up again.
text.normalized: The cast-down raiseth up again.
text.reading: The cast-down raiseth up again.

text.diplomatic: The eyes of all things, Lord, attend,
text.normalized: The eyes of all things, Lord, attend,
text.reading: The eyes of all things, Lord, attend,

text.diplomatic: And on thee wait that here do live,
text.normalized: And on thee wait that here do live,
text.reading: And on thee wait that here do live,

text.diplomatic: And thou, in season due, dost send
text.normalized: And thou, in season due, dost send
text.reading: And thou, in season due, dost send

text.diplomatic: Sufficient food them to relieve.
text.normalized: Sufficient food them to relieve.
text.reading: Sufficient food them to relieve.

text.diplomatic: Yea, thou thine hand dost open wide,
text.normalized: Yea, thou thine hand dost open wide,
text.reading: Yea, thou thine hand dost open wide,

text.diplomatic: And ev’rything dost satisfy
text.normalized: And ev’rything dost satisfy
text.reading: And ev’rything dost satisfy

text.diplomatic: That lives, and doth on earth abide,
text.normalized: That lives, and doth on earth abide,
text.reading: That lives, and doth on earth abide,

text.diplomatic: Of thy great liberality.
text.normalized: Of thy great liberality.
text.reading: Of thy great liberality.

text.diplomatic: The LORD is just in his ways all,
text.normalized: The LORD is just in his ways all,
text.reading: The LORD is just in his ways all,

text.diplomatic: And holy in his works each one.
text.normalized: And holy in his works each one.
text.reading: And holy in his works each one.

text.diplomatic: He’s near to all that on him call,
text.normalized: He’s near to all that on him call,
text.reading: He’s near to all that on him call,

text.diplomatic: Who call in truth on him alone.
text.normalized: Who call in truth on him alone.
text.reading: Who call in truth on him alone.

text.diplomatic: God will the just desire fulfil
text.normalized: God will the just desire fulfil
text.reading: God will the just desire fulfil

text.diplomatic: Of such as do him fear and dread:
text.normalized: Of such as do him fear and dread:
text.reading: Of such as do him fear and dread:

text.diplomatic: Their cry regard, and hear he will,
text.normalized: Their cry regard, and hear he will,
text.reading: Their cry regard, and hear he will,

text.diplomatic: And save them in the time of need.
text.normalized: And save them in the time of need.
text.reading: And save them in the time of need.

text.diplomatic: The LORD preserves all, more and less,
text.normalized: The LORD preserves all, more and less,
text.reading: The LORD preserves all, more and less,

text.diplomatic: That bear to him a loving heart:
text.normalized: That bear to him a loving heart:
text.reading: That bear to him a loving heart:

text.diplomatic: But workers all of wickedness
text.normalized: But workers all of wickedness
text.reading: But workers all of wickedness

text.diplomatic: Destroy will he, and clean subvert.
text.normalized: Destroy will he, and clean subvert.
text.reading: Destroy will he, and clean subvert.

text.diplomatic: Therefore my mouth and lips I’ll frame
text.normalized: Therefore my mouth and lips I’ll frame
text.reading: Therefore my mouth and lips I’ll frame

text.diplomatic: To speak the praises of the LORD:
text.normalized: To speak the praises of the LORD:
text.reading: To speak the praises of the LORD:

text.diplomatic: To magnify his holy name
text.normalized: To magnify his holy name
text.reading: To magnify his holy name

text.diplomatic: For ever let all flesh accord.
text.normalized: For ever let all flesh accord.
text.reading: For ever let all flesh accord.
